comment: The demo's six scenes (make demo). caption: shown on screen during the recording; spoken: what the voice says, for demo.srt. A voice clip line-<n>.wav per scene sets how long that scene lasts; without one, seconds is used.

lines.caption: The funder dashboard: where people handle the loans automation couldn’t fund
lines.spoken: This is the funder dashboard: the place where people handle the loans our automation couldn't fund on its own.

lines.caption: Sign in, and open a deal by its loan id
lines.spoken: I sign in, and open a deal by its loan id.

lines.caption: What’s been done: every check, and exactly why it passed or failed
lines.spoken: Right away I can see what's been done: every check, and exactly why it passed or failed. Here the TILA math is off by ten dollars.

lines.caption: Passed checks show their evidence too; the activity shows who did what
lines.spoken: Every passed check shows its evidence too, and the activity shows who did what.

lines.caption: The assistant summarizes the deal, with a local AI model on this laptop
lines.spoken: If I want the short version, the assistant summarizes the deal, using a local AI model on my laptop.

lines.caption: Code builds every screen and makes every change. The AI only explains.
lines.spoken: Code builds every screen and makes every change. The AI only explains.
